spellbook.finance/limitations: Starting a read changes nothing on the marketplace and nothing in inventory. It stores a preview that expires at expiresAt, 24 hours after it started.
Starting while a read is already running returns that read. Starting after a ready preview begins a new read, so use previewId latest to read the stored one.
status queued or reading means the marketplace has not been fully read yet. counts, cap, rows and unmatched are empty then, and missingFields names them. Wait and call again with previewId latest.

status failed carries error. ebay_call_limit means eBay's daily call allowance for SpellBook is used up, so start again later. owner_seat_required means the person who started the read no longer owns the workspace. tcg_snapshot_missing or tcg_snapshot_stale means the paired SpellBook extension has not captured a TCGplayer pricing export in the last 48 hours, so ask the person to open the TCGplayer seller portal with the extension paired, then start again. manapool_account_mismatch means the connected ManaPool login is not the account bound to this workspace.

observedAt is when the marketplace was read. For tcg it is when the read ran, and the listings come from the latest TCGplayer pricing export the paired extension captured. Listings sold, ended or edited after it are not reflected.
rows and unmatched hold the first 100 each, highest live price first. counts covers every listing read.

Each unmatched listing has one reason: variation_listing, lot_listing, graded_card, auction_listing, non_usd_price, zero_quantity, unsupported_game, no_card_identity, ambiguous_printing or condition_unknown. Those listings are not adopted.

matchSource spellbook_sku means the listing SKU is a SpellBook SKU. item_specifics means eBay's card item specifics named one printing. title means only the listing title text named it. catalog_id means a TCGplayer SKU or a ManaPool product id named it.
For tcg and manapool, listings SpellBook already manages are counted as already managed and left alone. A ManaPool read covers English singles only.
linkExistingUnits and createUnits are estimates at preview time. Apply recounts from live inventory.

cap reports the nominal 10,000-copy allowance as a soft limit. cap.verdict fits means managed listed copies plus the copies to adopt stay within it. not_applicable with nominalAllowanceExceeded true means they pass it: apply still adopts every listing, and nothing is charged or blocked. cap.managedListedUnitCount is the count before adoption and cap.countIsExact says whether it is a lower bound. cap.admission other than allowed means apply returns 409 until the workspace is owned or claimed.
Only Magic: The Gathering singles in US dollars are adopted in this version.

It needs a connected account on the channel. ebay_not_connected: get the setup page from spellbook_ebay_connect_link. tcg_not_connected: pair the extension with spellbook_tcg_extension_pairing. manapool_not_connected: get the link from spellbook_manapool_connect_link.

description: Read the live listings on the workspace's connected eBay, TCGplayer or ManaPool account and preview how each one maps to an exact printing, without changing the marketplace or inventory. Omit previewId to start a read. The read runs in the background, so the first answer has status queued or reading. Call again with previewId latest until status is ready. A ready preview lists adoptable listings with the printing, finish and condition read from each one, the facts that named it (matchSource), and how many copies link to owned items or need a new item. Unmatched listings carry one reason each. Show the person the counts and cap, then call spellbook_marketplace_listings_adopt_apply with the previewId.

channel.description: The marketplace whose live listings to adopt: ebay, tcg for TCGplayer, or manapool. Defaults to ebay.

context.description: Optional analytics context: briefly describe the user's underlying goal in one sentence. Do not copy prompts, personal details, credentials, identifiers, or tool arguments. Omit for private tasks.

previewId.description: Omit to start a new read of the live listings. Pass latest, or a previewId from an earlier call, to read a stored preview without a new eBay read.

workspaceId.description: The workspace whose connected marketplace account to read. Required. Only the workspace owner can start a read.

name: spellbook_marketplace_listings_adopt_preview
